recipe.title: SIGIL
recipe.description: Episode 5 for DOOM, with a MIDI soundtrack and optional paid replacements, including an Episode 3 compatibility path.
recipe.permission: Redistribution permitted with the bundled permission text intact and unmodified. See kept credits/readme members for full terms and resource credits.

components.label: SIGIL
components.description: Main episode/mapset with bundled MIDI music.

components.label: Episode 3 compatibility WAD
components.description: Free E3M1–E3M9 replacement for older ports; required by the paid E3 soundtrack. DSDA-Doom supports the native E5 UMAPINFO episode instead.

components.label: Buckethead soundtrack (REG WAD)
components.description: Paid SIGIL_V1_23_REG.wad: the complete E5M1–E5M9 episode with Buckethead's MP3 music embedded. Replaces SIGIL_V1_23.wad; never load both.
components.obtain: Purchase the SIGIL digital download or fan box from romero.com/sigil, then import SIGIL_V1_23_REG.wad (166,530,532 bytes). It is the paid replacement for the free MIDI WAD.

components.label: Buckethead E3 soundtrack (paid)
components.description: Paid SIGIL_SHREDS_COMPAT.wad: music-only MP3 soundtrack for the E3 compatibility maps. Enabling it also selects the free Episode 3 map WAD; it never replaces the native E5 episode.
components.obtain: Purchase the SIGIL digital download or fan box from romero.com/sigil, then import SIGIL_SHREDS_COMPAT.wad (162,146,269 bytes). It is music-only and must load after the Episode 3 compatibility map WAD.

components.label: Widescreen status bar
components.description: Optional widescreen (wide-aspect) base-game Doom/Doom II status bar from NightFright and contributors' doom_widehud (GPL-3.0); SIGIL ships no status-bar graphics of its own. Loads after the mapset and any gameplay add-on.

inspected: Archive sizes and SHA-256; WAD lump listings; DSDA-Doom v0.30.1 source
Owner-supplied SIGIL USB image V1.23 inspected read-only 2026-10-21: docs/research/reference-sigil.md §2.1 and docs/reports/068-sigil-purchased-editions.md
verification.notes: Confirmed archive/member identities and source inspection. The owner-supplied paid v1.23 USB image confirms SIGIL_V1_23_REG.wad is a complete 146-lump E5M1–E5M9 mapset carrying 11 Buckethead MP3 lumps; every non-music lump is byte-identical to the free WAD, so it replaces rather than augments it. SIGIL_SHREDS_COMPAT.wad is an 11-lump music-only add-on for the E3 compat path; the recipe models it as a paid imported component that requires the free compat maps and loads after them, never as a native E5 replacement. Complevel vanilla; no gameplay or audio test performed. Tags: cacowards = 2019 runner-up per https://www.doomworld.com/cacowards/2019/ (secondary evidence only: DoomWiki Cacowards 2019 via web search; doomworld.com blocks automated fetches, so the page was not read directly); classics = first free release 2019-05-01, over five years before this review; episode = nine maps E5M1–E5M9 (docs/research/reference-sigil.md); featured = D-010 reference recipe. Widescreen status bar credit: doom_widehud by NightFright and contributors (GPL-3.0), https://github.com/NightFright2k19/doom_widehud; SIGIL_V1_23.wad replaces no status-bar lump, so the base-game Doom/Doom II bar is offered.
limitations: Needs Deck Validation: IWAD/complevel, load order, gameplay, audio and episode menu.
SIGIL_V1_23_REG.wad MP3 playback is supported by DSDA-Doom v0.30.1's SDL_mixer path per source inspection but was not played; remains Needs Deck Validation.
SIGIL_SHREDS_COMPAT.wad is music-only and is valid only after SIGIL_COMPAT_V1_23.wad; it is not needed on DSDA-Doom's native E5 path and is never a complete E5 replacement.
